name: copilotprompts-prompt-m365-agent-or-not-prompt
title: Agent or Not?
shortDescription: Use Microsoft 365 Copilot and available Work IQ context to decide which recurring tasks should become a Copilot Studio agent, stay a prompt, or become a Power Automate flow.
longDescription: Ask Microsoft 365 Copilot to review your recurring work from the last 30 days in email, Teams, meetings, and your calendar. It recommends which tasks should become a Copilot Studio agent, which should stay a simple prompt, and which need a Power Automate flow, then drafts agent instructions and a suggested trigger for each agent recommendation. With work grounding, available Work IQ context can personalize the result within your access permissions. Review every recommendation before you build anything.
